roles.description: Engineered high-performance, real-time web graphics for live esports broadcasts, specializing in bridging the gap between dynamic data and professional streaming environments (OBS).
keyContributions: **Real-Time Graphics:** Developed animated, browser-based overlays using modern JavaScript frameworks for seamless OBS integration.
**Data Integration:** Architected API-driven systems to display live match stats, rankings, and team events with sub-second latency.
**Performance Tuning:** Optimized rendering pipelines and animations to ensure a stable 60 FPS during high-traffic live streams.
**Reliability:** Ensured precise synchronization between live gameplay data and on-screen visual elements.
